input_contract: Require each named chunk to be sealed_complete, exploratory, and already pinned by flow_recovery_v1. Refuse unsealed, reserved, missing or unpinned input. Verify store identity, parent plan, index/seal SHA, exact seal inventory, capture manifest, raw and metadata hashes, and source pins. Hold the store lock for provenance snapshot and final recheck only; root-owned pins protect the intervening stream. No automatic input replacement. Each batch contains three independent 600-second captures with explicit gaps. Reset all features at capture boundaries and invalidations. Retain all ten assets and both venues.
event_definition: Anchor one-second receipt buckets to integer elapsed seconds from capture start; close only when the receipt stream reaches the bucket end. Admission: 60 <= bucket start <570 seconds. Use deduplicated ordinary live trades and exact raw Decimal base quantities; split fills are additive. Background [t0-60s,t0) needs >=20 prints across >=10 receipt seconds and uninterrupted known book/trade generation since window start. Dominant side needs >=80% of total base quantity. Choose the latest prebook received <=t0 with source <=minimum burst trade source, then require both source and receipt age <=250ms at t0. Native side levels must be valid. Fixed consumed-side band: [preask,preask*1.0005] for buys, [prebid*.9995,prebid] for sells; displayed far boundary must cover the band. Dominant quantity >=25% of predepth. The first advancing same-generation postbook with receipt >=bucket end, source >=maximum burst source, receipt-source <=250ms and receipt <=bucket end+500ms determines postdepth. If depletion is <25%, reject without searching later books. Thin qualifying depleted episodes first per ASSET across venues, at 30-second spacing; count repeats.
confirmation: Choose the first advancing same-generation book with receipt AND source >=bucket end+2s, receipt-source <=250ms, and receipt <=due+500ms. Use the same fixed price band. Zero band depth is valid if the book covers the band and its touch moved beyond it. Continuation=(same-aggressor base quantity RECEIVED in [bucket end,bucket end+2s)/2)/initial one-second side quantity. Recovery=(current fixed-band depth-postdepth)/(predepth-postdepth). slow_recovered: continuation <=.25 and recovery >=.5. persistent_unrecovered: continuation >=.75 and recovery <=0. Retain intermediate states. Record maximum trade source age in the burst and confirmation intervals. Any known ordinary trade in either interval with receipt-source >500ms makes the candidate unusable as stale_trade_interval; do not drop it and infer quiet. Zero observed continuation means observed slowdown, not parent-order completion or certified trade completeness. All invalidations and capture end clear state and pending candidates with explicit failures.
